title: Skills
subtitle: Instructions your agents load when a task fits them. Turning a skill on does not trust it.
col.name: Name
empty.title: No skills in this realm yet
empty.body: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md in it, under ~/.hoody/skills on the computer. Agents load it when a task fits.
allRealms.title: Pick a realm to see its skills
allRealms.body: Skills belong to one realm. Choose a realm from the realm menu at the top (on a phone, tap the realm square).
detail.notFound: This skill is not in the list any more
use.title: Use
use.note: Turns {{name}} on or off for every agent in this realm. It does not change trust.
use.untrustedOn: On, but not trusted: agents see its name only and its commands do not run.
use.shadowed: Not used: the copy in {{where}} has the same name and is used instead. This copy turns on and off with it.
use.broken: Agents can’t use it: its SKILL.md could not be read.
use.held: Turning {{name}} {{state}} may have gone through. Check again reads the list; nothing is sent again.
use.heldElsewhere: A change of {{name}} sent from another place may have gone through. It is checked there.
use.dismissBody: It may still have gone through. Check the list before you change this skill again.
trust.title: Trust
trust.body.local: Made on this computer: agents use it as written.
trust.body.trusted: Installed and trusted: agents use it as written.
trust.body.untrusted: Installed and not trusted: its description and instructions are withheld and its commands do not run.
trust.body.changed: Its files changed since it was installed, so it is not trusted: its instructions are withheld and its commands do not run.
facts.title: Details
files.title: Files in this skill
files.info: The skill’s instructions and the files it brings with it.
files.none: This skill has no other files.
files.readBad: The agent answered without the text of this file.
fact.errorValue: Its SKILL.md could not be parsed.
hub.title: Skill Hub
hub.subtitle: Find skills others have published, read one, then install exactly what you read.
hub.trust: Skills are written by other people. Read one before you install it: it installs off and not trusted.
hub.label: Skills found
hub.col.sourceTip: Where its author published the skill. It opens that page in a new tab.
hub.col.installsTip: How many times people installed it from this hub. Not a review.
hub.old: These results are from an earlier search and may be out of date.
hub.badPreview: We couldn’t read this skill, so nothing can be installed from it. Go back and try again.
hub.f.name: Name
hub.frontmatter: Header fields (as the agent read them)
hub.bodyNote: Its SKILL.md without the header fields above.
hub.commands_one: Once trusted, this skill runs {{count}} command when it loads.
hub.commands_other: Once trusted, this skill runs {{count}} commands when it loads.
hub.noCommands: It runs no commands when it loads.
hub.filesNote: The other files’ contents are not shown here. They are installed with it, exactly as listed.
hub.installHelp: Installs this exact package, off and not trusted.
hub.taken: A skill is already in the folder {{folder}}. Replacing it deletes that skill.
hub.replaceBody: The skill now in {{folder}} is deleted and this package takes its place, off and not trusted. This cannot be undone.
hub.held: Installing {{name}} may have gone through. Check again reads the list; nothing is sent again.
hub.heldElsewhere: An install into this folder sent from another place may have gone through. It is checked there.
imp.title: Import skills
imp.subtitle: Copy skills that Claude Code or Codex keep on this computer.
imp.lands: An imported skill starts off and not trusted. Agents load it only after you turn it on. Its commands run only after you trust it.
imp.badScan: We couldn’t read the list of skills. Try again.
imp.where.claude: Claude Code’s skills on this computer (~/.claude/skills).
imp.collision: A skill of this name is already in {{where}}.
imp.busy: An import of this skill is not settled yet.
imp.listReading: This computer’s skills list is not read yet. Import waits for it.
imp.broken: Its SKILL.md cannot be read, so it cannot be imported.
imp.sensitive: Some of its files look like they hold secrets and would be copied too: {{files}}
imp.noResult: The result for this skill didn’t arrive, so it may have been imported. Nothing is sent again. Check again reads the list.
imp.exists: A skill is already in {{folder}}. Nothing was copied.
imp.dupInBatch: Another selected skill has the same name, so this one was not imported. Nothing was copied.
imp.held: Importing {{name}} may have gone through. Check again reads the list; nothing is sent again.
imp.heldElsewhere: An import into this folder sent from another place may have gone through. It is checked there.
imp.replaceBody: The skill now in {{folder}} is deleted and this copy takes its place, off and not trusted. This cannot be undone.
add.notTaken: {{folder}} no longer holds a skill, so nothing was sent. Press again to add it there.
add.readFirst: Nothing was sent: the skills list could not be read first. Try again.
